mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (compared to the previous month) compresses discount rates on equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is lower than the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% and rising from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% and UNRATE increased in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% and increased in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) signals an overheating economy, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1,350,000 units and industrial production (INDPRO) above 103.0 (index) signals an overheating economy, prompting monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where the regime is late-cycle expansion and HOUST > 1350.0 and INDPRO > 103.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1,400,000 units signals an overheated housing market, which may lead to a recessionary shock and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals an economic contraction and monetary tightening, which together depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During early recovery phases, a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102.0 (index) and a decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals strengthening economic activity, which supports equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where the regime is early recovery and INDPRO > 102.0 and UNRATE < 4.0%.
